column3: The Start menu is the Meta key
column4: Press the Windows key (called Meta here) and start typing: apps, settings and even pages of the guide show up.
Click the menu button in the panel, or press Alt+F2 and type the app's name.
Meta+E opens Dolphin, the file manager. Your Documents, Downloads and Pictures are on the left.
Open the File Manager from the menu (Thunar). Your Documents, Downloads and Pictures are on the left.
Stepping away? Meta+L locks the screen, just like Win+L.
Stepping away? Ctrl+Alt+L locks the screen.
Meta+V shows the last things you copied, like Win+V on Windows.
Ctrl+Alt+T opens the terminal. The guide's commands are typed there; nothing to fear.
Press Print Screen: Spectacle opens and lets you grab the whole screen, a window or a rectangle.
Press Print Screen to take a screenshot and choose where to save it.
Alt+Tab switches windows, Alt+F4 closes one. Your Windows muscle memory still works.
Meta+W shows all open windows side by side (like Task View). Click one to jump to it.
Copy, paste and undo are the same as on Windows, in every app.
Meta+Left and Meta+Right put a window on one half of the screen, like on Windows.
Drag a window to the left or right edge of the screen to make it fill that half.

column3: Your Task Manager is Mission Center
column4: Something slow or frozen? Open Mission Center from the menu to see what's using the computer and stop it.
Meta+. (full stop) opens the emoji picker. Search for 'heart' or 'thumbs'.
With the Bitwarden extension, Ctrl+Shift+L fills in the login for the site you're on.
Alt+Space opens KRunner: type a file name, an app, a sum (12*7) or a unit (5 km in miles).
With the Bitwarden extension, Ctrl+Shift+L fills in the login for the site you're on.
Updates download quietly and install when you restart. No surprise reboots in the middle of your work.

column3: An error message you don't understand?
column4: Copy it (select it, Ctrl+C), then open 'Explain This Error' from the menu: your private offline AI explains it in plain English.
Ctrl+Alt+T opens Konsole. The guide's commands are typed there; nothing to fear. That's your last tip: well done!
That's your last daily tip. The START-HERE guide on your Desktop has everything else. Well done!
